versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Ant Design (antd) design-language assistant.
- Explains Ant Design’s core values, 10 design principles, and visual language with psychological and scientific reasoning.
- Supports learning, applying, critiquing, and theming Ant Design UIs, including deep dives into design-science and UX laws.
- Compares Ant Design to other systems (Material Design, Apple HIG, Fluent, Carbon, and top Chinese design systems).
- Includes practical reference files for specs, tokens, theming, UI review checklists, and cross-system comparisons.
